source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Inspect the inspection sheet
3. Look for a brake test, and click on it
4. Look for a passing brake test on the sheet
5. Click on last column of test.
6. Observe the failed brake test
7. Document the results of the test in the report
8. Select a reason code
9. Select any reason code that might lead to the failure of the brake test.
10. Start the process.
11. Click on the `Next` button and you will see a report of the failed tests listed in the results.
12. Notice a message that says `Re-enter Details` and another message that says `Please verify that the reason codes selected for this test are valid.`
13. Click on the `Next` button.
14. Observe the report of the brake tests that failed.

## Conclusion

All of the reasons highlighted are valid and satisfy the
